item.title: Friday 1 PM Update, Nov 20
item.description:
The Friday 1 p.m. update from Gumshoe News Radio for November 20, 2026: Londonderry, New Hampshire weather through tomorrow morning; President Trump's post-Asia news conference and a judge lets his New York Times libel suit go forward; Israel's push for new Iran strikes and the source of the chemical plot warnings, and Saudi-led strikes on Houthi targets in Yemen; the S&P 500 slides into a correction as Anthropic falls back to its IPO price; Signal blocks AI agents from reading your screen; an Anthropic mathematician claims a Claude-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis; SonicWall's end-of-life warning and new Bazuka Android malware; your X feed; school health insurance costs, Nongfu Spring leaves Nashua and Saturday's craft fair; and England's first lifelong guardianship ceremonies for care leavers. Anchor Ava, with Andrew at the business and tech desk.

item.title: Friday Morning, Nov 20
